components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-only opt-in acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares a
            household (same last name and address) with an existing owner. When true,
            the same-household duplicate check is skipped; otherwise a matching owner
            causes the create to be rejected with 409.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners who deliberately share a household
                (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created with
                'sharesHousehold' true and a matching owner already exists; both the new
                owner and the existing household member(s) carry the same value. Absent
                for owners that do not share a household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true

I implemented `namesakeCount` on `POST /api/owners` — the number of existing owners (before this create) sharing the same firstName and lastName, case-insensitively — following the codebase's existing pattern for create-time derived fields like `customerCode` and `householdId`.

Changes:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added a read-only `namesakeCount` integer property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` gains the field (MapStruct maps it automatically by name).

3. **Schema files** (`hsqldb`, `h2`, `postgres`, `mysql`) — added the `namesake_count INTEGER` column to the `owners` table.

4. **`AssignNamesakeCount.java`** (new OfficeFloor function) — counts existing owners whose firstName and lastName match the new owner's (case-insensitively) and stores it on the owner. It runs before the owner is saved, so the count excludes the owner being created — matching the "before this create" semantics.

5. **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired the new `assignNamesakeCount` step into the pipeline between `assignCustomerCode` and `save` (under the same `transaction` governance).

The value is computed and persisted at creation time (a snapshot, per the spec's "before this create" wording), then returned on `GET /api/owners/{id}`. The `Cp13Tests` case — two owners sharing "Ann"+surname yielding `namesakeCount = 1` for the second — passes, and all 22 tests remain green.
